query: For an existing customer of an RBI-regulated entity, does the duty to obtain PAN or Form 60 apply on 1 September 2025?

gold_obligations.clause_text: In case of existing customers, RE shall obtain the Permanent Account Number or equivalent e-document thereof or Form No. 60, by such date as may be notified by the Central Government, failing which RE shall temporarily cease operations in the account till the time the Permanent Account Number or equivalent e-documents thereof or Form No. 60 is submitted by the customer.
gold_obligations.clause_summary: Requires regulated entities to obtain PAN (or Form 60) from existing customers by the notified date, or temporarily stop operating the account until it is provided -- unless the customer could not provide it due to injury, illness, or age-related infirmity, in which case the RE's internal policy must allow continued (but more closely monitored) operation.

query: Does regulation 23 (related-party transactions) apply on 1 June 2025 to an SME-Exchange-listed entity with paid-up equity capital of Rs 12 crore?

gold_obligations.clause_text: With effect from April 01, 2025, the provisions of regulation 23 shall be applicable to a listed entity whose equity shares are listed on the SME Exchange, where such entity has paid-up equity share capital exceeding Rupees ten crore or net worth exceeding Rupees twenty-five crore, as on the last day of the previous financial year; once applicable, this continues to apply unless both thresholds remain below the limit for three consecutive financial years.
gold_obligations.clause_summary: Determines when an SME-Exchange-listed company must start following SEBI's related-party-transaction rules (regulation 23): once its paid-up equity capital crosses Rs 10 crore OR its net worth crosses Rs 25 crore, as measured at the end of the previous financial year.
